title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 333 West Broadway in Anaheim, California, as the "Dr. William I. 'Bill' Kott Post Office Building".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the U.S. Postal Service located at 333 West Broadway in Anaheim, California, as the Dr. William I. 'Bill' Kott Post Office Building.

summary.headline: Congress named a Post Office building in Anaheim, California, after Dr. William I. 'Bill' Kott.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 333 West Broadway in Anaheim, California, as the Dr. William I. 'Bill' Kott Post Office Building. It changes only the name of the building. It does not change postal services, hours, or rules.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on November 25, 2024, and the name change took effect on that date.
